subject: general
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

Some cats are dogs.All dogs are animals.

Conclusions:

I. Some cats are animals.

II. All cats are animals.
solution:
**Given:**

Some cats are dogs

All dogs are animals

**Formula used:**

Some A are B + All B are C ⇒ Some A are C

**Calculation:**

Some cats are dogs

All dogs ⊂ animals

⇒ Some cats are animals ✔

But no statement says All cats are dogs

⇒ All cats are animals ✘

**∴ Only Conclusion I follows.**
